notes.title: Introducing....The Atlas Mystery: A VR Puzzle Game
notes.content:
OUT NOW! A brand new, full-length escape room puzzle game from the studio behind Belko VR!
You’ve survived the twisted offices of Belko Industries… now uncover the dark history behind the Atlas Theater.

[previewyoutube=mn7qDLK1Jzw;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1787320/The_Atlas_Mystery_A_VR_Puzzle_Game/]Find Atlas in the Steam Store [/url]

Solve dozens of intricate puzzles and uncover startling artifacts as you venture deep into a 1940’s era movie palace and discover the truth behind a shocking Hollywood tragedy.
For fans of escape rooms and exploratory puzzle games like [i]Myst,[/i] [i]The Room VR: A Dark Matter,[/i] [i]The Witness[/i], [i]I Expect You To Die[/i], and [i]Red Matter.[/i]

[h3]Releasing on Steam and Oculus App Lab April 13th![/h3]
